title: The stability conjecture for the Bernoulli problem in dimension four
summary: We prove that every global classical stable solution to the one-phase Bernoulli problem in $\mathbb R^4$ is one-dimensional. In particular, if nonempty, its free boundary consists of one or two parallel hyperplanes. This settles the stability conjecture for the Bernoulli problem in dimension four. As consequences, we obtain universal local Hessian and free-boundary curvature estimates for classical stable solutions in $\mathbb R^4$, as well as axial symmetry of global classical solutions with finite Morse index in $\mathbb R^4$.
